purpose: Canonical terminology guardrail for Riftbound expert answers.

stats_and_costs.energy: Energy cost to play a card.
stats_and_costs.power: Rune/domain cost requirement, not combat damage.
stats_and_costs.might: Unit combat stat; use this for combat strength/damage/survivability language.

forbidden_terms.reason: Not a canonical Riftbound domain. Use Body, Calm, Chaos, Colorless, Fury, Mind, or Order.
Legends of Runeterra terminology. Riftbound uses domains.
Legends of Runeterra terminology, not Riftbound.
Legends of Runeterra terminology unless explicitly discussing a non-game proper noun.

canonical_event_lookup_rule: For event answers, open root pipeline event records such as events/rq-lille-2026.json first when available, then compare events/canonical/ only as a normalized secondary copy.
canonical_source_rule: Never answer from archived or legacy roots unless the user explicitly asks for historical/archived material.
